corrections.reason: Core product category is preserved (physical products → physical appliances + devices). POST only adds an inclusion ('appliances') and a functional descriptor; the organizing frame remains product-centric. Reframed requires a frame shift, which is not present here. Narrowed is wrong because scope broadens rather than restricts. Confirm Elaborated.

Both share a specific smart-home product/capability neighborhood (devices that integrate a home). Narrowed fails: 'Seamless home integration is a specific way of being smart home devices' is false — integration is an outcome/enablement, not a product subtype. Elaborated fails: the noun itself shifts from product-category to functional-outcome, which is a frame change (product-centric → outcome/integration-centric), not added modifiers on the same noun. Same semantic territory, shifted organizing frame → Reframed stands.

shared smart-home product neighborhood; POST specifies the functional outcome the devices deliver

semantic_events.rationale: Core product category retained; 'appliances' added alongside 'devices' and a functional clause is attached. Frame remains product-centric; no scope restriction (not Narrowed) and no frame shift (not Reframed).

Shared smart-home product/capability neighborhood. POST reframes from product-category label to the experiential/functional outcome the products deliver (product-centric → outcome/integration-centric). Narrowed fails the subsumption test; Elaborated fails because the organizing noun shifts.
